statements.name: PROC QRUN
statements.description: The PROC QRUN statement specifies the circuit input, execution target, and other procedure-level options.

arguments.name: CIRCUIT=
arguments.description: specifies the name of the two-level circuit data set to execute, display, or transpile.

arguments.name: DATA=
arguments.description: specifies a parameter-binding table, which runs one parameter set per input row and preserves other columns as copyvars.

arguments.name: PROVIDER=
arguments.description: specifies the execution provider.

arguments.name: IBM
arguments.description: runs your circuit on IBM hardware with the specified options.

arguments.name: CHANNEL=
arguments.description: specifies the IBM connection channel.

arguments.name: DEVICE=
arguments.description: specifies the device or simulator to run on. You must specify this suboption whenever you specify a named provider. The DEVICE= option is not required when you use the local provider.

arguments.name: INSTANCE=
arguments.description: specifies the IBM instance routing.

arguments.name: TOKEN=
arguments.description: specifies the IBM token directly in SAS code.

arguments.name: DEVICE=
arguments.description: specifies the device or simulator to run on. You must specify this suboption whenever you specify a named provider.

arguments.name: NOISE=
arguments.description: specifies a simulator noise model.

arguments.name: NTHREADS=
arguments.description: specifies the maximum number of threads to allocate per worker.

arguments.name: SIMMETHOD=
arguments.description: specifies the representation of the local simulation.

statements.name: OBSERVE
statements.description: The OBSERVE statement computes the Pauli expectation values of the observables.

arguments.name: OUT=
arguments.description: specifies the output data set that expectation values are written to.

arguments.name: PAULIS=
arguments.description: specifies the list of observables to evaluate as a space-delimited list of terms.

arguments.name: DETAIL
arguments.description: requests one row per Pauli term rather than a single combined result.

arguments.name: NUMSHOTS=
arguments.description: requests a sampling-based estimate.

statements.name: SAMPLE
statements.description: The SAMPLE statement runs the circuit and returns measurement outcomes.

arguments.name: OUT=
arguments.description: specifies the output data set that measurement counts are written to.

arguments.name: NUMSHOTS=
arguments.description: specifies the number of repeated circuit runs.

statements.name: TRANSPILE
statements.description: The TRANSPILE statement rewrites a circuit for a target device without executing it.

arguments.name: DEVICE=
arguments.description: specifies the target device of the transpilation.

arguments.name: GATESOUT=
arguments.description: specifies the output data set for the transpiled circuit in quantum assembly language (QASM) row format.

arguments.name: MAXTIME=
arguments.description: specifies the maximum amount of time (in seconds) to wait for transpilation.

arguments.name: METAOUT=
arguments.description: specifies the output data set for transpilation summary statistics.

arguments.name: OPTIMIZE=
arguments.description: specifies the optimization effort. Higher integers signify more effort.

arguments.name: OUT=
arguments.description: specifies the output data set for the per-gate counts of the transpiled circuit.

arguments.name: SEED=
arguments.description: specifies a seed to make stochastic transpilation reproducible.
